description: The expression language as the writing application implements it: the host language, the rewriting applied to the text before it runs, the object model, the evaluation rules and limits, and test vectors. Profile document section 8 is the narrative; this payload is the list.

coverage.description: Exactly what this definition covers and what it does not.

evaluation.description: When an expression runs, with what inputs, what its result is, and how the result becomes the property's value.

host_language.description: The language the text is written in.

names.description: The names of the object model the writing application defines.

items.description: One name of the object model.

kind.description: What it is. `value`: a value; `function`: a function; `object`: an object with members of its own.

name.description: The name as an expression writes it.

on.description: What it is a member of: `global`, `comp`, `layer`, `property`, `key`, `marker`, `footage`, `text`, `path`, `camera`, `light`.

signature.description: How it is written, with its arguments.

rewriting.description: How the text is changed before it is run (array arithmetic).

sandbox.description: What an expression can and cannot reach, the limits on its work, and what the application does on its own when a file is opened.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's schema. Always 1 in profile motion-comp/1; a reader refuses the node (node scope) when it is anything else.

test_vectors.description: Test vectors, each computed by the writing application's engine when the file was saved.

items.description: A test vector: an expression, where it is evaluated, and the value it yields in the writing application.

context.description: Where it runs: `time` (seconds of composition time), `value` (the property's keyframed value: a number or an array), and the facts of the layer and composition the expression reads (`index`, `width`, `height`, `frame_duration`...).

result.description: The value: a number, an array of numbers, a boolean or a string.

tolerance.description: The largest difference per number a conformant engine may have.

title: core.expr.language
